description: Source code for watchdog driver implementation for ARM Cortex-M3 microcontroller, including initialization, mode setting, and trigger functions for independent and windowed watchdog timers.

methods.name: Wdg_IWDG_Init
methods.description: Initializes the independent watchdog with provided configuration.

methods.name: Wdg_WWDG_Init
methods.description: Initializes the windowed watchdog with provided configuration.

methods.name: Wdg_Init
methods.description: Initializes both independent and windowed watchdogs.

methods.name: Wdg_IWDG_Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the independent watchdog to prevent reset.

methods.name: Wdg_WWDG_Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the windowed watchdog to reset its counter.

methods.name: Wdg_IWDG_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the mode (off, fast, slow) for the independent watchdog.

methods.name: Wdg_WWDG_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the mode (off, fast, slow) for the windowed watchdog.

methods.name: Wdg_IWDG_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information for the independent watchdog driver.

methods.name: Wdg_WWDG_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information for the windowed watchdog driver.
